question: In Δ ABC, AB = 20 cm, BC = 7 cm and AC = 15 cm. Side BC is produced to D such that Δ DAB ~Δ DCA. The length of CD is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0ad3807e8e615c524aa5aa30f72f4b4198d5dd51c63c7438bd3c166a5ddddd0.png] 

Given, ΔDAB ~ ΔDCA

Let, ∠D = 90°

In ΔDAB, AB = 20 cm then other sides are 16 cm and 12 cm

In ΔDCA, AC = 15 cm then other sides are 12 cm and 9 cm

∴ The length of CD is 9 cm

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

In Δ ABC, AB = 20 cm, BC = 7 cm and AC = 15 cm

ΔDAB ~ ΔDCA

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f992da8c7198653f4ca7a6552f1b04191a6c709fabd4b31a756bf5f01a7284f7.png] 

Let, CD = x and AD = y

AB/AC = DB/AD = AD/DC

⇒ 20/15 = (x + 7)/y

⇒ 4/3 = (x + 7)/y

⇒ y = (21 + 3x)/4 .....(1)

Also, AB/AC = AD/DC

⇒ 20/15 = y/x

⇒ y = 4x/3 .....(2)

From (1) and (2),

(21 + 3x)/4 = 4x/3

⇒ 16x = 63 + 9x

⇒ 7x = 63

⇒ x = 63/7 = 9

**∴ The length of CD is 9 cm**
